connector.name: Agentfetch
connector.registryDescription: Token-budgeted web fetch for AI agents - auto-routes Jina, FireCrawl, Trafilatura, PDF.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package agentfetch-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bch1212 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: JINA_API_KEY
env.description: Jina Reader API key. Free tier ~1M tokens/mo at jina.ai/reader.

env.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
env.description: FireCrawl API key for JS pages. 500 free credits at firecrawl.dev. Optional.

env.name: REDIS_URL
env.description: Redis connection URL for response caching. Optional.
